sources.title: Teleporting an unknown quantum state via dual classical and Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen channels
sources.claim: Quantum-state teleportation protocol using entanglement and classical communication.
sources.non_claim: Not transport of a macroscopic object.

sources.title: Quantum teleportation
sources.claim: Quantum teleportation transfers quantum information rather than matter.
sources.non_claim: No spatial aperture transmitting physical matter.

sources.title: Wormholes, Time Travel, and Faster-Than-Speed-of-Light Theories
sources.claim: No observed wormhole or known physical construction mechanism.
sources.non_claim: Not empirical proof wormholes are physically realizable.

sources.title: Traversable wormholes via a double trace deformation
sources.claim: Theoretical traversability in a specified gravitational and holographic setting.
sources.non_claim: Does not describe a built physical portal.

sources.title: Traversable wormhole dynamics on a quantum processor
sources.claim: Quantum processor reproduced predicted information dynamics in a model.
sources.non_claim: No physical spacetime rupture or macroscopic object transfer.

sources.title: Wormhole 2022 experimental Q&A
sources.claim: Research team states no physical rupture of spacetime was made.
sources.non_claim: The result is not an actual traversable ambient-spacetime portal.

sources.title: Author Correction: Traversable wormhole dynamics on a quantum processor
sources.claim: The 2022 paper's Fig. 3b caption was clarified to describe averaging over all fermions.
sources.non_claim: A caption correction does not establish an actual macroscopic traversable wormhole.

sources.title: Experiments implementing small commuting models lack gravitational features
sources.claim: Published Matters Arising critique challenges whether the small commuting model displays gravity-like features.
sources.non_claim: A critique of a quantum simulation is not a finding that physical two-way object portals exist or are constructible.

sources.title: Reply to: Experiments implementing small commuting models lack gravitational features
sources.claim: Authors argue the relevant two-sided teleportation process, rather than every Hamiltonian process, merits the proposed holographic interpretation.
sources.non_claim: Does not claim an actual macroscopic object travelled through physical space via a wormhole.

sources.title: NIST Handbook 44: Specifications, Tolerances and Other Technical Requirements for Weighing and Measuring Devices (2026 Ed.)
sources.authors: Minnich et al., National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.claim: NIST publishes technical requirements concerning accurate and repeatable weighing-device performance.
sources.non_claim: Commercial measurement requirements do not by themselves certify a custom PhaseGate load-cell system.

sources.title: Overview of the Recommended Guide for Determining and Reporting Uncertainties for Balances and Scales
sources.claim: Scale calibration uncertainty must be assessed and reported rather than assumed from nominal digit resolution.
sources.non_claim: Higher ADC count resolution alone does not establish accurate mass or a novel physical effect.

sources.title: Raspberry Pi Camera Module 3 product information
sources.claim: Camera Module 3 offers a 12-megapixel Sony IMX708 autofocus camera with standard and wide fields of view.
sources.non_claim: Camera footage alone cannot prove spatial matter transfer and image clocks require synchronization validation.

sources.title: HX711 24-Bit Analog-to-Digital Converter for Weigh Scales datasheet
sources.claim: HX711 is a load-cell ADC with pin-based serial interface and selectable 10 or 80 samples per second nominal output.
sources.non_claim: ADC bit depth and nominal samples per second do not guarantee true physical mass precision or event fidelity.
